text:
marcus: opened PR to tidy up quota + pricing pages and fix a handful of broken links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5432
marcus: goals: show a tiny minute-vs-month example for metering, replace legacy SDK header snippet, and make Grafana links durable.
tara: thanks. For the metering example, please include both a short timeline (showing burst credits applied per-minute) and a calc row for the monthly invoice preview. Customers keep mixing the two windows.
tara: added PromQL examples to the PR: `sum(rate(redwood_usage_tokens_total[1m])) by (customer_tier)` for minute view and `sum(increase(redwood_usage_tokens_total[30d])) by (customer)` for billing.
elaine: swapped the header snippet to SDKv2 shape in the PR: `X-Redwood-Usage: user=acct_9, units=150, unit_type=tokens` and added a note: do not paste live API keys.
elaine: also added a compact curl sample with redacted key:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \n  -H 'X-Redwood-Usage: user=acct_9, units=150, unit_type=tokens' \n  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize..."}'
```
marcus: nice. One editorial change: rename tier label "alpha" -> "early" to match product copy and add a small mapping table for legacy customers.
tara: FYI ops reported panel ids differ between staging and prod. ops-bot: Recommend linking to the dashboard slug (`/d/usage/overview`) without panelId for durability; avoid internal org URLs.
ops-bot: If a direct panel anchor is necessary we should add a short redirect in edge cases; opened ops ticket OPS-1129.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-5432--docs.redwood.ai — please eyeball the dashboard links and the downloadable CSV example at /examples/billing-preview.csv
elaine: I'll do a quick pass on staging and post screenshots if anything 404s. If preview looks green I'll merge before the docs cut. :thumbsup:
